title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Claim Frequency Load at Renewal
content:
For renewals under the residential renewal schedule of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** (Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier), the program renewal rate carries a load for the number of claims reported under the program.

**Claim frequency load.** The program renewal rate per 100 is multiplied by 1.08 when 5 or more claims were reported under the program's certificates in the last 12 months, each claim counted once by its first notice of loss, by 1.04 when 1 to 4 were, and by 1.00 when none was.

**What is counted.** Claims, not payments: each claim is counted once, on the date its first notice of loss was reported, whatever has been paid, voided or denied on it since. A renewal window of the last 12 months covers every claim reported on a day from which fewer than 12 whole calendar months have passed by today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

| Claims reported in the last 12 months | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1.00 |
| 1 to 4 | 1.04 |
| 5 or more | 1.08 |

*Example (hypothetical):* a program with four claims reported in the window, one of them denied, counts 4 and takes 1.04.
